ads.headline: Service businesses seeing better ROI with video ads over static creative
actions: Audit your current ad creative - count static images vs video ads in active campaigns
Create one 15-second phone-recorded video showing your service in action this week
Split test: allocate $12.50/day to video, $12.50/day to your best static ad for 7 days
ads.source: r/FacebookAds weekly discussion threads - service provider lead gen focus

creative.headline: Can't generate strategy — Google Trends data showing zero volume across all metrics
actions: STOP: The data provided shows 0-100 scores of zero for all three tracked terms, with no performance comparisons or engagement metrics included
Need actual data: Post-level engagement rates (likes, comments, saves, shares), audience demographics, DM conversion data, and which content types generated 'ADS' DMs
Without real performance data showing what worked vs. failed this week, any recommendation would be a guess that could waste your content calendar
creative.source: Incomplete dataset — Google Trends shows no search volume data provided; missing Instagram Insights metrics (reach, impressions, engagement rate by content type); missing competitor analysis or audience feedback

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
